name: Camp Becket and Chimney Corners Camp (Becket-Chimney Corners YMCA)
description_short: Overnight YMCA camps (Camp Becket and Chimney Corners Camp) in Becket, MA, for campers finishing 2nd–9th grade. They offer 4-week traditional sessions, 2- and 3-week first-camp options, and specialty programs, with tiered pricing that lets families choose what they pay.

warnings: The page covers two overnight camps (Camp Becket and Chimney Corners) plus Becket Day Camp. This listing covers the 2027 overnight sessions.

Prices are tiered: families choose Tier 1 (full cost) through Tier 4. 2027 ranges: 4-week Traditional $6,650–$8,300, Construction & Adventure Odyssey $7,350–$9,150, 2-week $3,500–$4,400, 3-week $5,250–$6,600. Session prices are left blank because there is no single price.
The 2-week and 3-week First Camp Experience options are for first-summer campers finishing 2nd–4th grade only.
The page still includes 2026 tables with different dates and prices, including 2026-only Day Camp ($345–$445/week, ages 5–12) and Trailblazers rates. Don't mix them up with 2027.
Financial aid deadlines conflict: Sept 30, 2026 for the first round (already passed) vs. a Tier 5 deadline of November 15. Later applications are reviewed as funds allow.
Grades are 'finishing' grades, meaning the grade the camper finishes in the school year before camp.
